test_isolation.focal_wrapper:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Get-ChildItem Env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '(?i)(ETORO|ALPACA|MASSIVE|POLYGON|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|CREDENTIAL|API_KEY|PROXY|UV_ENV|PYTEST_ADDOPTS|PYTHONPATH)' } | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath ('Env:' + $_.Name) }
$env:BOT_MODE = 'offline'
$env:ORDER_SUBMISSION_ENABLED = 'false'
$env:UV_NO_ENV_FILE = '1'
$env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD = '1'
& .\scripts\uv.ps1 run --offline --frozen pytest -q tests/test_demo_only_identity.py tests/test_demo_pre_send.py tests/test_etoro_transport.py tests/test_etoro_websocket_probe.py
exit $LASTEXITCODE
